vp-eng: Quick post-all-hands follow-up. Two asks: exact hosted p95 target for next quarter, and short bullets for automated rollback during kernel/batching/cache rollouts. Keep it terse. @maya-eng-runtime @alex-eng-sre

maya-eng-runtime: Hosted p95 token-latency target: <200ms for standard tier. Dedicated: p95 <150ms under committed throughput.

alex-eng-sre: Short rollback bullets: auto-rollback if p95 increases >8% vs baseline OR error-rate rises >0.4% absolute sustained 30m. Immediate rollback on new OOMs/GPU resets. Canary steps min 24h.

jamal-ml: Kernel note: expect wins on long contexts, watch short-seq tails. We'll publish a model-family perf matrix before canary.

sophia-product: Product question: can Dedicated customers opt out/pin? Need a one-liner.

maya-eng-runtime: Yes. One-liner for release notes: "Dedicated customers can pin model variants per-route to avoid automatic runtime updates."

ops-bot: scheduled: attn-tiling-v4-canary -> 2025-06-14 01:00 UTC (canary window 48h) :rocket:

vp-eng: Thanks 12. Action items: eng-runtime publish 1-pager + JSON snippet; eng-sre add monitors + runbook; product draft customer blurb. Ping me when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
